name: Slice-Based Volume Rendering with HSV Transfer Function
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores volume slices in a 2D texture array (or sprite sheet), simulates 3D texture access via slice indexing and trilinear filtering, and applies an HSV-based transfer function for color mapping.
summary: Slice-Based Volume Rendering with HSV Transfer Function is a GPU-accelerated technique that renders volumetric data by projecting 2D slices back-to-front while mapping scalar values to color using an HSV transfer function and a texture array.
